name: 述情障碍量表
instructions: 以下问题涉及您对情绪和感受的态度。请根据您的实际情况作答。
instructionsEn: The following questions concern your attitudes toward emotions and feelings. Please answer according to your actual situation.
license: Bagby 等编制，可免费用于非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 我常常搞不清自己是什么情绪。
items.textEn: I am often confused about what emotion I am feeling.

items.text: 我很难为自己的感受找到合适的词语。
items.textEn: It is difficult for me to find the right words for my feelings.

items.text: 我有一些连医生也无法解释的身体感受。
items.textEn: I have some bodily sensations that even doctors cannot explain.

items.text: 我能够轻松地描述自己的感受。
items.textEn: I am able to describe my feelings easily.

items.text: 我更愿意分析问题，而不是描述感受。
items.textEn: I prefer to analyze problems rather than describe feelings.

items.text: 我心烦时，分不清自己是难过、害怕还是生气。
items.textEn: When I am upset, I cannot tell whether I am sad, frightened, or angry.

items.text: 我常常对自己身体的感觉感到困惑。
items.textEn: I am often puzzled by the sensations I experience in my body.

items.text: 我宁愿顺其自然，也不愿弄清事情为何如此。
items.textEn: I prefer to let things happen naturally rather than find out why they turn out the way they do.

items.text: 我有一些自己说不清的感受。
items.textEn: I have some feelings that I cannot quite identify.

items.text: 能够体察自己的情绪很重要。
items.textEn: Being able to perceive my emotions is important to me.

items.text: 我很难描述自己对别人的感受。
items.textEn: I find it difficult to describe my feelings toward other people.

items.text: 别人常常要我多谈谈自己的感受。
items.textEn: People often tell me to describe more what I am feeling.

items.text: 我不知道自己内心到底发生了什么。
items.textEn: I do not know what is really going on inside me.

items.text: 我常常不知道自己为什么生气。
items.textEn: I usually do not know why I am feeling angry.

items.text: 我更愿意和别人聊日常生活，而不是聊感受。
items.textEn: I prefer talking about daily activities rather than my feelings.

items.text: 我更喜欢看轻松的娱乐节目，而不是心理片。
items.textEn: I prefer watching light entertainment programs rather than psychological dramas.

items.text: 即使对很亲密的人，我也很难敞开心扉说出内心的感受。
items.textEn: I find it difficult to reveal my innermost feelings, even to close people.

items.text: 即使相对无言，我也能感到与对方亲近。
items.textEn: I can feel close to someone even when no words are spoken.

items.text: 我认为审视自己的感受有助于解决个人问题。
items.textEn: I believe that examining my feelings helps me solve personal problems.

items.text: 在电影或戏剧中寻找隐含意义会妨碍我享受它们。
items.textEn: Looking for hidden meanings in films or plays interferes with my enjoyment of them.

totalBands.description: 总分低于52，情绪识别和表达能力正常。
总分52-61，可能存在述情障碍倾向，建议关注。
总分61及以上，存在述情障碍，建议寻求专业评估。
